kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننسلب (form VII)
# نَنْسَلِبُ (nansalibu) /nan.sa.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# نَنْسَلِبَ (nansaliba) /nan.sa.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# نَنْسَلِبْ (nansalib) /nan.sa.lib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
